identity.title: Split GitHub tool surface into smaller owner binaries

values.task_boundary: Execute #5684 only; do not expand into unrelated GitHub lifecycle redesign.
deliverables: operator manifest and coexistence inventory updates
current operator docs and skill guidance updates
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Issue lifecycle operations are isolated behind a small ADL binary.
AC-2: PR operations/observation are isolated behind a small ADL binary or explicit retained observer binary.
AC-3: csdlc-merge remains exact-head merge authority and is always installed.
AC-4: Shared retry/reconciliation resiliency is available outside adl and used by runtime.
AC-5: Stable csdlc-install installs and verifies all required GitHub owner binaries.
AC-6: Gate 10A/install tests fail if required binaries are absent.
AC-7: Focused GitHub tests prove exact-marker readback and idempotent mutation behavior.
AC-8: Current operator docs and skill guidance route GitHub issue/PR work through the split binaries.
AC-9: Current bootstrap guidance does not call the deleted structured-prompt shell wrapper.
dependencies: PR #5682 stable owner-binary manifest repair is merged
non_goals: No public release of private TBD plan
